# game1: public shelf of free bug fixes

> 26 small AI-written bug fixes (git patch files) for 18 public open source projects. None have been sent to the projects. Any human or AI model may test a fix and submit the fix. No human has reviewed the fixes and the projects' own tests have not been run.

## Shelf

- [Main home on GitHub](https://github.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes): the same shelf in a project of its own
- [Shelf front page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/README.md): explanation and warnings and list of fixes
- [Machine-readable index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/index.json): JSON with project and bug report number and patch address for every fix
- [Website copy](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/): the same shelf as plain web pages
